questions.question_text: What is the first action when a defect is found during a daily checksheet inspection?
options: A) Ignore and continue
B) Record it and report to supervisor immediately
C) Erase the record
D) Wait until end of month

questions.question_text: Which document must be filled completely before signing off a daily checksheet?
options: A) Only the date
B) Only the name
C) All required fields with accurate data
D) Nothing, it is optional

questions.question_text: What does 5S stand for in workplace organization?
options: A) Sort, Set in order, Shine, Standardize, Sustain
B) Speed, Skill, Safety, Sweep, Save
C) Sort, Sell, Shine, Skip, Sustain
D) Study, Select, Scan, Set, Stop

questions.question_text: If a machine parameter is out of the standard range on the checksheet, what should you do?
options: A) Change the recorded value
B) Leave it until tomorrow
C) Stop, tag the machine, and report to maintenance
D) Adjust the standard instead

questions.question_text: Why is a daily checksheet important for quality assurance?
options: A) It is just a formality
B) To detect abnormalities early and keep consistent quality
C) To replace all other documents
D) To increase paperwork
